page.overview:
What is Umbreon?

Umbreon is a -type Pokémon who appears in Pokémon Mystery Dungeon Gates to Infinity Animated Trailer (Part 2).

Umbreon, along with Espeon, used his own power to open the Magnagate, a portal to distant, secret dungeons. Along with other Pokémon, Umbreon went through the portal and was transported in an icy chamber. However, Umbreon fell down, unconscious, even when he tried to get Virizion back on its feet.

None of Umbreon's moves are known. Category:Dark-type anime Pokémon Category:Male anime Pokémon Category:"Pokémon that can Talk" Category:Mystery Dungeon characters
